notes.title: We can play online Co-op! 【Playtest】Version 0.4.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Online co-op is here!!
Online co-op is here!!!
Online co-op is here!!!!



Do you feel like single-player mode isn’t exciting enough? Do your NPC teammates feel underwhelming? Can’t find local buddies to play couch co-op with?



From now on!! These won’t be issues anymore!!!!



In version 0.4.0, we’re introducing the online multiplayer feature! Players can create rooms and invite friends to play together online! No more spatial constraints—enjoy a thrilling match with your friends anytime, anywhere!



However, the multiplayer function is still in the testing phase, so there may be some unknown bugs. If you encounter any, feel free to report them to us! We’ll fix them as soon as possible!



Discord: 

https://discord.gg/kPJK7VvhRV



Thank you, fellow Demon Kings!!

notes.title: I'm No Demonlord — Steam Version 0.3.0 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
New Features & Improvements  ：
Dear players of DemonLord,
With this Playtest update, we will be pausing further updates temporarily as we fully devote ourselves to preparing the upcoming demo release and official version content. We kindly ask for your understanding!
Here are the details of the Version 0.3.0 update:

Experience Optimization:
1、Improved cursor transparency display logic in two-player mode.
2、Performance optimized to reduce lag in late-game stages.
3、Difficulty indicators now show as "Corrosion Level" under Corrosion mode.
4、Defense damage reduction and cooldown effects are now visually displayed.
5、The day ends immediately after defeating a boss — no more waiting time.
6、Shortened settlement time at the end of each in-game day.
7、Stage-clear text now adapts to the selected difficulty.
8、The game will pause when a controller is plugged/unplugged or when switching to background.
9、Emotes now have a built-in minimum cooldown to prevent crashes caused by rapid macro usage.
10、Game now launches in windowed mode by default with second-tier resolution.
11、Fixed lag issue when quickly switching description panels.
12、Fixed a bug where bonus shadow damage was not being triggered correctly.
13、Unlock pop-ups now display all newly unlocked content at once — no more confirming one by one.
14、Added a language selection screen when first launch.

Combat Adjustments
1、Cooldown reduction is now calculated as n / (n + x).
2、New Mechanic – Swift Casting. When triggered, it randomly reduces the current cooldown of one skill by 10%.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/c83215ab89d4d8c85ed26a92b5f456a3db8d219d.jpg
3、"Frost Armor" Adjustment:Trigger chance changed from
[100%, 100%, 100%, 100%, 100%] to [20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%].
4、"Summoning Staff" Adjustment: Damage changed from [0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.4, 1.6] to [1, 1.3, 1.6, 1.9, 2.2].  Penetration changed from [1, 1, 1, 1, 1] to [2, 2, 2, 2, 2].

Art Optimization:
1、Added new transition animations.
2、Added new main menu interface.
3、Added new general button animation effects.
4、Adjusted artwork for minor enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/c49f46ad7090a04b3765f367c6e5c4b06c9c3dab.gif
5、Adjusted artwork for magic missiles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/0809d2535e0ce2722dc92501acac2e5f0ea8a179.gif

notes.title: I'm No Demonlord — Steam Version 0.2.6 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
1. Platform Support
We’re excited to announce that the game is now fully supported on Steam Deck and macOS! 
Dive into the adventure on your favorite platform — anytime, anywhere.

2. New Feature: Blessing System
Introducing the all-new Blessing System!
Before entering Corrosion Challenges, players can now gain a corresponding Blessing Level. Based on your character’s unique traits, use your Blessing Level to enhance attributes in advance and prepare for the battles ahead!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/0d9a036b05f1654863d9d33eef446a40c1e65622.jpg

3. Experience Optimizations
- Cross-platform save data is now supported!
- A new Screen Shake toggle has been added to the Settings menu.
- Cursor style has been adjusted when using a controller for a smoother experience.

4. Combat Adjustments
- The default system behavior of selecting talents at the end of the day has been changed. After the update, you can now switch back to immediate talent selection via the Settings menu.
- The price growth for repeated item purchases has been reduced: from 150% → 120%.
- Battle time during the first four days has been slightly increased by 5 to 10 seconds.
- Bosses will now flash red as a warning before casting major skills.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/abd7953de744da8e53d19e86b78dacdd7af9a09e.gif
- Boss combo cooldown increased: from 4s → 5s.
- Boss HP bonus reduced: from 100% → 50%.
- All boss skills have been slightly nerfed for better balance.
- Cheerer speed aura effect reduced: from 100% → 50%.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/777c184d67e285a03b33d816e395400b3682a9c6.gif
- In high difficulty, daily HP recovery has been adjusted: no healing per day → recover 30% HP per day.
- Normal difficulty is now unlocked by default, and new players will start on Normal difficulty.
- The "Cultivating Immortality" ability has been reworked: at the start of each day, gain +1 HP regeneration per second permanently.
- New Challenge Stage Reward: You now get one additional talent selection opportunity after clearing challenge stages.

 5.Bug Fixes
- Fixed the issue where non-Hell difficulty playthroughs would reset the Corrosion unlock status.
- Fixed an issue where some computers would fail to load icons properly.
- Fixed a bug where the character would randomly die under certain conditions.
- Fixed an issue in Two-player mode where characters could not be revived properly.
- Fixed an issue in Two-player mode where NPC tombstones could be moved.

notes.title: I'm No Demonlord — Playtest Version 0.2.4 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Grettings, Demonlords! 
After a 6-day free playtest, we’re excited to roll out our first major update! Below are the details for Version 0.2.4. Keep the feedback coming, and enjoy the new challenges!  

 New Features & Improvements  
1. Corrosion System Added 
  - After clearing the highest difficulty, players can now customize corrosion levels to push your limits.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/ca7358c2db2fe4d30036f153a18393394c1efe2d.gif

2. Revamped Text Description System  
  - Streamlined lengthy descriptions and added subtext for exclusive keywords.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/fe53dcda7f4dadb9cfc0f72120f4412b0a566027.gif

3. New Weapon: Ice Spear  
  - The first ice-element melee weapon, offering crowd control and breakthrough capabilities.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/09cf3072d507ec0b8ff770ce811e62c24155ac4f.gif

4. Overhauled Demonlord Weapon: Blood Blade  
  - Reworked from a bloodsucking weapon to a bleed-type weapon, rapidly stacking bleed effects on enemies.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/ec3d7021ad56eec4f4033e59896357503b657726.gif

5. Player Bug Report List  
  - Added a dedicated feedback section on the main menu for international players.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/3af5a27716c4c54406141ebbaa1beda6c0786b68.jpg

6. Magic Sphere Visual Adjustments  
  - Improved visibility in combat and reduced battlefield obstruction caused by the spheres.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311648/589a942975a581322481d4dd44a5efd43a0ac7f1.gif


 Balance Adjustments  
1. Enemy Speed Scaling
  - High-difficulty enemy speed now increases gradually.  
 
2. "Caress of the Goddess of Pain" Mechanic  
  - No longer triggers when player HP is below 15%.  
 
3. Bullet Hell Build (BD) Tweaks  
  - Splitting Power: Damage adjusted from [-10, -20, -30, -40, -50] → [-12, -24, -36, -48, -60].  
  - Wave Power: Damage adjusted from [-10, -20, -30, -40, -50] → [-12, -24, -36, -48, -60].  
  - Rounding: Minimum damage adjusted from [5, 10, 15, 20, 25] → [4, 7, 10, 13, 16].  
  - Tiny Bow: Bullet count adjusted from [1, 2, 2, 3, 3] → [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]; attack waves adjusted from [1, 1, 2, 2, 3] → [1, 1, 1, 1, 1].  
 
4. Level-Up Weight Adjustments  
  - Increased weight for level-up refreshes, making progression smoother.  
 
5. Build Tag Adjustments  
  - Removed "Melee" and "Remote" tags from all extra bullet talents/abilities.
  - Added "Blast" tag to "Blood blast"-related talents/abilities.  

 Bug Fixes  
1. Fixed abnormal coin gain from catching thieves in treasure rooms for certain builds.  
2. Corrected display errors for tier 1/2 items in shops.  
3. Fixed locked icon visibility after unlocking new difficulties.  
4. Resolved UI overflow issues in build display panels.  
5. Patched infinite loop crashes caused by specific mechanic interactions.
